articles.title: Why Can't I Register an Account?
articles.body:
If you cannot complete registration and you are blocked before entering your address or identity details, it means our security systems detected a risk signal connected to your device, network, or contact information. This is automatic and happens to protect players and prevent fraud.

Common reasons why registration is blocked:

  • Email or phone number has a risk history
    If the email or phone number you entered has been associated with suspicious behavior on other platforms or services, our external security tools may classify it as high risk. Even if the activity did not happen on CoinsRaid, these signals can block registration.
  • Your device or network is flagged
    If the device, browser, or IP address you are using has been linked to unusual or high-risk activity in the past, the system may automatically stop new account creation. This can include multiple failed signups, shared devices, or previously flagged activity.
  • Third-party fraud signals
    We use industry-standard fraud-prevention partners that compare patterns across many global services. If they detect that your contact details, device fingerprint, or behavior match known fraud or abuse patterns from outside CoinsRaid, the system will prevent registration.
  • Region or IP restrictions
    If your IP address indicates a restricted location, registration is automatically stopped. See Can I play CoinsRaid in my state?
  • You already have an account
    Each player can only have one CoinsRaid account. Multiple accounts under the same person, household, or device are not allowed. See Can I Have More Than One Account?
⚠️ Always use your own devices, disable VPNs, proxies or anonymizers. Use a trusted network (e.g., home Wi-Fi) and use only your personal email with no prior fraud history.

articles.title: What Are Bonus Coins and How Do They Work?
articles.body:
Bonus Coins are extra Gold Coins (GC) or Sweeps Coins (SC) that you can earn through promotions, missions, and special events. They’re designed to make your CoinsRaid experience more rewarding and fun while you explore new games and levels.

Bonus Gold Coins (GC):

  • Used for entertainment play only.
  • GC have no cash or monetary value, are not redeemable for cash or prizes, and may not be exchanged, transferred, assigned, or sold.
  • Often given as part of welcome offers, the Daily Lootbox, or promotional events.

Bonus Sweeps Coins (SC):

  • Awarded freely through promotions, missions, or Alternate Method of Entry (AMOE).
  • Must be played at least once (1×) on eligible slot games before becoming Redeemable SC.
  • Can’t be used on table games, live dealer, video poker, or specialty games until converted.
  • Once converted, Redeemable SC can be used in any eligible sweepstakes game or redeemed for prizes after verification.

XP (Experience Points):

  • XP measures your activity and progress across CoinsRaid.
  • You earn XP by playing games, completing missions, and participating in events.
  • As your XP increases, you advance through levels in the Raider’s Guild, unlocking new rewards, bonuses, and collectibles.

Can I send my coins to a friend?

❗ Bonus Coins and XP are personal and non-transferable. They can’t be traded, sold, or shared between accounts.

articles.title: Frequently Asked Questions
articles.body:
How do I create a CoinsRaid account?

Go to https://coinsraid.com/ and click the Register button. For details see How to Create Your CoinsRaid Account.

How old do you have to be to play at CoinsRaid?

You must be at least 18 years old to play CoinsRaid. In some states, the minimum age is higher. For details, see How to Create Your CoinsRaid Account. General Terms & Conditions also may apply.

Can I have more than one account?

No. Each player may only create and maintain one CoinsRaid account. For details, see Can I Have More Than One Account?

Can I play for free without buying anything?

Yes — use the Alternate Method of Entry (AMOE) to receive free Sweeps Coins with the same odds as any other SC.

How do I take a break or self-exclude?

Use the self-exclusion feature in your account’s Responsible Gaming section. For more details check Responsible Gaming: How It Works.

Can I play while traveling or using a VPN?

Access depends on your verified location; VPNs, proxies or blocked states can limit play and redemption.

Why is my account suspended?

Your account may be temporarily restricted due to verification, location checks, or compliance reviews. For details, see Why Is My Account Restricted or Suspended?

Can I send my coins to a friend?

No. Coins can’t be transferred, gifted, or shared between accounts. Each CoinsRaid account is personal, and all Gold and Sweeps Coins must be used only by the registered player. For details, see What Are Bonus Coins and How Do They Work?

Why am I unable to redeem my prize?

You can’t redeem a prize if your account isn’t fully verified, you’re in a restricted state, or your Sweeps Coins haven’t met the 1× playthrough requirement. Make sure your verification is complete and you’re using Redeemable SC from an eligible location. For details, see How to Redeem Prizes and How to Verify Your Account.

How do I purchase Gold Coins?

You can purchase Gold Coins directly from your account dashboard using credit/debit cards, e-wallets, or other accepted payment methods. Each Gold Coin package also includes bonus Sweeps Coins.

What's the difference between Gold Coins and Sweeps Coins?

Gold Coins (GC) are for entertainment play only and cannot be redeemed for prizes. Sweeps Coins (SC) can be redeemed for cash prizes after meeting playthrough requirements. Both types let you play the same games.

How long does account verification take?

Most verifications are completed within 24-48 hours. You may be asked to provide a government-issued ID, proof of address, or other documents. Check your email and account notifications for updates.

How do I contact customer support?

You can reach our support team via live chat on the website, email, or through your account dashboard. Support is available 24/7 to assist with account questions, technical issues, and redemption inquiries. See How to get Support.

What happens to my coins if I self-exclude?

During self-exclusion, your account is locked and you cannot access your coins or play games. After the exclusion period ends, your coin balance will be restored and available for use.

Can I reset my password if I forgot it?

Yes. Click the Forgot Password link on the login page and follow the instructions sent to your registered email address to reset your password securely.

Are my winnings taxable?

Prizes may be subject to federal and state taxes depending on the amount and your location. CoinsRaid will provide necessary tax documentation (such as Form 1099) for qualifying redemptions. Consult a tax professional for specific guidance.

How long does it take to process a redemption?

Redemption processing typically takes 3-7 business days after your request is approved. The exact time depends on your chosen payment method and any additional verification requirements.

What is the minimum redemption amount?

The minimum redemption is typically 100 SC (Sweeps Coins). Check your account dashboard for current redemption thresholds and available redemption options.

Do my Gold Coins or Sweeps Coins expire?

Gold Coins and purchased Sweeps Coins generally do not expire. However, bonus coins received through promotions may have expiration dates. Check the specific terms for each promotion.

Can I play on my mobile device?

Yes. CoinsRaid is fully optimized for mobile browsers on iOS and Android devices. Simply visit the website from your mobile browser to play — no app download required.

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), e-wallets, and other secure payment methods. Available options may vary based on your location.

What does the 1× playthrough requirement mean?

You must wager your Sweeps Coins at least once before they become redeemable. For example, if you have 100 SC, you need to place bets totaling 100 SC before you can redeem those coins for prizes.

Can I change my email address or personal information?

To change your email or other personal details, contact customer support. Some changes may require additional verification to ensure account security.

Which states is CoinsRaid available in?

CoinsRaid is available in most US states. However, certain states have restrictions on sweepstakes gaming. Your location is verified when you log in, and access is automatically determined based on your verified location.

Are there Daily Lootbox rewards or promotions?

Yes. CoinsRaid regularly offers Daily Lootbox rewards, special promotions, and seasonal events. Check your CoinsRaid Hub to see current offers.

What happens if I have a technical issue during gameplay?

If you experience a technical issue, contact customer support immediately with details about the game and issue. Our team will investigate and resolve any problems with your gameplay or coin balance.

articles.title: What is CoinsRaid and how it works?
articles.body:
CoinsRaid is an online social entertainment platform where players can enjoy fun, interactive games, complete missions, and earn rewards through play.

It’s built to give you an exciting, fair, and transparent gaming experience — all from your browser or mobile device.

A New Kind of Play Experience

CoinsRaid combines the best parts of gaming and rewards into one platform.

Here you can:

  • Play a variety of fast, easy-to-learn games.
  • Progress through missions and earn XP for achievements.
  • Take part in events and challenges.
  • Collect rewards that can later be redeemed*

Every feature is designed to make gameplay enjoyable and social, without pressure or risk.

*For current redemption procedures and processing timelines, reach out to customer support. Processing time may vary depending on verification and compliance status.

articles.title: Why Is My Account Restricted or Suspended?
articles.body:
Your CoinsRaid account may be temporarily or permanently restricted for a few reasons, usually related to security, verification, or compliance requirements. These measures help keep gameplay fair and protect both players and the platform.

Common reasons for account restrictions:

  • Identity verification not completed: Your KYC (Know Your Customer) check may still be pending or incomplete. Verification is required before redeeming prizes or continuing gameplay.
  • Multiple declined payments: Repeated failed or declined Gold Coin purchase attempts can trigger a temporary restriction to protect against payment fraud.
  • Duplicate or linked accounts: Only one CoinsRaid account is allowed per person or household. Duplicate accounts are automatically flagged and reviewed by Compliance.
  • Responsible play limits: If you’ve set a timeout, purchase limit, or self-exclusion, your account will remain restricted until the selected period ends.
  • Fraud or unusual activity: Accounts flagged by our security systems for suspicious or automated behavior may be paused for manual review.
⚠️ Always use your own verified details, keep payment information consistent, and avoid using VPNs or shared devices to prevent automatic restrictions.

articles.title: Why Did My Coins or Balance Expire?
articles.body:
If your Sweeps Coins (SC) balance has disappeared or decreased, it may have expired due to inactivity.

Here’s how expiration works:

  • Sweeps Coins (SC) expire after 60 consecutive days of inactivity.
  • Inactivity means no login, gameplay with Gold or Sweeps Coins, or prize redemption attempts during that time.
  • Once SC expire, they can’t be restored, even if you log in again later.

Gold Coins (GC)

  • Gold Coins never expire.
  • However, they have no monetary value and can’t be redeemed for prizes.

How to keep your account active:

Simply log in or play any game at least once every 60 days to keep your Sweeps Coins safe and active.

articles.title: Can I Have More Than One Account?
articles.body:
Short answer — No.

Each player can only have one CoinsRaid account.

Duplicate, shared, or linked accounts, including those created by the same individual under different credentials, are strictly prohibited.

This rule helps keep gameplay fair and protects everyone from fraud or abuse. Our security systems automatically detect duplicate or linked accounts through device, IP, and identity checks.

If more than one account is detected:

  • All related accounts may be suspended or permanently closed.
  • Any associated balances or prizes may be forfeited in accordance with the Fraud Prevention & Bonus Abuse Policy.

articles.title: Alternate Method of Entry (AMOE) - Play for Free
articles.body:
You don’t need to make a purchase to play or win on CoinsRaid.

Every player has access to our Alternate Method of Entry (AMOE) — a completely free way to earn Sweeps Coins (SC).

Keep in mind AMOE is only available for users with no funds in their Sweeps Coins wallets. If you have funds, please use them first.

How it works:

  1. Go to the AMOE Portal on our website.
  2. Complete the online AMOE form with your full name, email, mailing address, and date of birth.
  3. Generate and print your pre-filled entry with a QR code.
  4. Mail your printed entry to the address provided in the instructions.

Once verified, you’ll receive 1 Sweeps Coin (SC) credited to your account for each valid mail-in entry. These coins work exactly the same as all other SC — they can be used in promotional games and redeemed once verified.

Important notes:

  • There’s no purchase or payment required to enter or win.
  • You can submit multiple entries unless otherwise limited by ongoing promotions.
  • AMOE entries have the same odds of winning as any other method of obtaining SC.
  • AMOE entries are processed after verification and may take some time.

If you prefer, you may also handwrite your AMOE entry following the same format — as long as it includes your personal details and a signed acknowledgment of CoinsRaid’s Terms of Use.

articles.title: How to Create Your CoinsRaid Account
articles.body:
Getting started with CoinsRaid takes just a few minutes. You can create your account directly from your browser and start playing right away. No downloads or complex setup required.

  1. Go to the CoinsRaid website.
    Click "Register" on the homepage.
  2. Enter your details.
    Provide a valid First name and Last name, email address, choose a password, agree to the Terms and Conditions and click "Confirm".
  3. Verify your email.
    You’ll receive a short confirmation link. Open it to activate your account.
  4. Set up your profile.
    Pick a username, choose an avatar, and explore your dashboard. You can update these details anytime in Profile.
  5. Start playing.
    Once your account is active, you can explore games, complete missions, and earn rewards immediately.

Before redeeming prizes, you may be asked to verify your identity to confirm age and location. This helps keep CoinsRaid fair, secure, and open only to eligible players.

articles.title: How to Verify Your Account
articles.body:
Before you can redeem prizes or take part in certain features, your CoinsRaid account needs to be verified. Verification confirms that each player is of legal age and located in an eligible region.

❗ For your safety, please don’t send any ID photos, documents, or personal details in chat, email or any other place except Shufti Pro.
⚠️ Verification should only be done through the secure Shufti Pro link inside Your Account.

1. Open your account settings

Go to the My Profile menu and select "KYC". You can also access this directly at: coinsraid.com/profile?tab=KYC

2. Submit your information

You’ll be asked to provide:

  • Full legal name
  • Date of birth
  • A valid government-issued photo ID
  • Proof of address (for example, a utility bill or official document)
  • Residential address
  • A unique identification number such as a national ID or tax ID
💡 Additional documents or information may be requested if required for enhanced verification or compliance purposes.

3. Wait for confirmation

Verification usually takes some time once your documents are submitted. You’ll receive an email when your account is confirmed.

4. Why verification matters

It helps ensure that:

  • Only eligible players can redeem prizes
  • Each account belongs to a real person
  • The platform stays safe and secure for everyone

Once verified, your account is fully active, and you can continue playing, joining events, and redeeming prizes.

articles.title: How to Earn Sweeps Coins (SC)
articles.body:
Sweeps Coins (SC) are free promotional entries that let you play sweepstakes-eligible games and redeem prizes. You can collect them in several easy ways, with no purchase required.

Ways to earn SC:

  1. Daily Login Rewards
    Log in each day to claim free SC as part of your daily reward streak. The longer your streak, the better the rewards.
  2. Missions and Challenges
    Complete in-game missions or limited-time challenges to earn Bonus SC. You’ll find these under the "Missions" tab on your CoinsRaid dashboard.
  3. Promotional Events and Giveaways
    Join special events, social promotions, or loyalty milestones to receive additional SC. Keep an eye on your inbox and notifications for limited-time campaigns.
  4. Gold Coin Bundles (Free Gift)
    When you buy Gold Coins (GC) for entertainment play, you’ll often receive a free gift of SC with your purchase. SC are never sold directly. They’re always provided as a free bonus.
  5. Alternate Method of Entry (AMOE)
    You can always earn SC for free by submitting a mail-in entry through our AMOE process. Each valid entry gives you 1 SC, and these coins work exactly the same as all others.

Important:

  • SC can’t be purchased directly, traded, or transferred between accounts.
  • All SC are promotional and hold no cash value until they become Redeemable SC through gameplay and verification.

articles.title: How to Play on CoinsRaid
articles.body:
Playing on CoinsRaid is quick and simple. You can start enjoying games right after signing up — no downloads or setup needed.

1. Log In to Your Account

Visit the CoinsRaid website and log in using your registered email and password. If you’re new, you can create an account in just a few minutes.

2. Explore the Game Library

From your dashboard, browse through the available games. Each game has its own theme, style, and mechanics, but all are built for entertainment and social play.

3. Choose How You Want to Play

You can play using different types of coins:

  • Gold Coins let you play for fun and practice.
  • Sweeps Coins allow you to take part in sweepstakes-style gameplay for prizes once your account is verified.

You can switch between the two modes anytime before starting a game.

4. Earn Progress and Rewards

Every round you play helps you earn XP, complete missions, and unlock rewards. XP tracks your journey on CoinsRaid — it’s your way of seeing progress and achievement over time.

5. Join Missions and Events

Keep an eye on community challenges and limited-time events. These offer extra rewards and are a fun way to explore new games and compete with other players.

6. Play Responsibly

CoinsRaid includes tools to help you set limits, take breaks, or pause your account whenever you need. For more information check Responsible Play Basics and Responsible Gaming: How It Works.

articles.title: How to Reset Your Password
articles.body:
You can access your CoinsRaid account anytime from your browser on desktop or mobile. Logging in and recovering access are quick and secure.

Resetting Your Password

If you’ve forgotten your password:

  1. Go to the CoinsRaid website.
  2. Click "Log In" on the homepage.
  3. Click "Forgot your password?" on the login screen.
  4. Enter your registered email address.
  5. Check your inbox for a password reset link.
  6. Create a new password and confirm it.

Account Security Tips

  • Use a strong, unique password that you don’t share elsewhere.
  • Avoid saving passwords on public or shared devices.
  • If you suspect someone has accessed your account, change your password immediately and contact Support.

articles.title: How to Redeem Prizes
articles.body:
Redeeming prizes on CoinsRaid is simple and secure. Follow the steps below to request your redemption and receive your rewards safely.

1. Make Sure You’re Eligible

Before you can redeem, please check that:

  • You’ve completed KYC verification (identity, address, and liveness check).
  • You’re physically located in an eligible U.S. state.
  • You’re redeeming Sweeps Coins (SC) that have become Redeemable SC — meaning they’ve met the 1× playthrough on eligible slot games.
  • Your account is active and not under self-exclusion or review.
⚠️ Please note that the minimum amount required for redemption is $100.

(If you haven’t completed verification yet, you can do it directly from your Profile page — see How to Verify Your Account.)

2. Submit a Redemption Request

  1. Go to your Redeem Page.
  2. Select eligible Redeemable SC.
  3. Confirm your request — you’ll see a confirmation message once it’s received.

3. Verification & Review

  • Every redemption request is checked automatically to confirm eligibility and identity.
  • If your KYC verification is complete and there are no issues, your redemption will move straight to processing.
  • If additional verification is required, we’ll email you right away with clear instructions.

(Please don’t send documents over chat or email — use the secure upload link we provide.)

4. Processing Time

  • Once approved, redemptions are typically processed within 3 business days after KYC approval.
  • Some requests may take longer if additional compliance checks are needed (for example, payment partner review or fraud screening).
  • You’ll receive an email notification once your redemption is completed.

5. Important Rules

  • Redemptions are only available for Redeemable SC — Gold Coins cannot be redeemed.
  • For players in New York or Florida, each individual redemption is limited to $5,000 or less.
  • CoinsRaid may request additional documentation if required by law or payment partners.
  • Annual redemptions over $600 may require IRS Form 1099 for tax purposes.
  • All redemptions are final once processed.

6. Common Questions

Why is my redemption still pending?
Most likely your KYC or compliance review is still in progress. You’ll be notified once it’s cleared.

Can I redeem if I only use AMOE (mail-in entries)?
Yes — AMOE players follow the same redemption process once their identity is verified.

Can I cancel or change a redemption request?
Once submitted and under review, redemptions can’t be modified. If you need help, contact Support.

articles.title: Responsible Play Basics
articles.body:
At CoinsRaid, we want gameplay to stay fun, social, and balanced. While CoinsRaid doesn’t involve real-money gambling, we still provide tools that help you manage your time and spending in a healthy way.

Here’s how you can stay in control:

  • Take breaks or timeouts: You can pause play for a chosen period (from 24 hours up to 1 year). During a timeout, your account remains safe, and you’ll regain access automatically afterward.
  • Self-exclusion: If you ever need a longer break, you can self-exclude temporarily or permanently. While excluded, you can’t log in, purchase coins, or redeem prizes.
🚑 If you ever feel your play habits are affecting your well-being, you can take a break at any time using our Responsible Gaming tools.

If you need additional support, you’ll find helpful gaming and digital wellness resources listed below, including organizations that specialize in managing screen time, gaming habits, and online behavior.

  • The Center for Internet and Technology Addiction: https://netaddiction.com/
  • Digital Wellness Institute: https://www.digitalwellnessinstitute.com/
  • Restart Life (Internet & Gaming Addiction Treatment): https://www.restartlife.com/

Remember — CoinsRaid is about having fun. Take breaks, enjoy the games, and play responsibly.

articles.title: How to Update Your Account Information
articles.body:
You can view and manage your account details anytime from your CoinsRaid profile page.

To update your information:

  1. Log in to your CoinsRaid account.
  2. Go to My Profile.
  3. Update any editable fields.
  4. Click Save to confirm.

Important:

  • Once your account has been verified through our KYC process, certain details (like your full name, date of birth, and country) cannot be changed for security and compliance reasons.
  • If you need to correct a mistake in verified information, please contact our Support Team via live chat.
  • Make sure your email and phone number are always up to date so you can receive important account and verification notifications.
💡 Use a strong password and update it regularly to keep your account secure.

articles.title: Supported Devices and Access
articles.body:
You can enjoy CoinsRaid directly from your web browser. No downloads or installations are required. The platform is fully optimized for both desktop and mobile browsers, so you can play anytime, anywhere.

Currently supported:

  • Desktop browsers: Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari (latest versions recommended).
  • Mobile browsers: Safari on iOS and Chrome on Android.

CoinsRaid is also compatible with other modern browsers, as long as they are regularly updated and support standard web technologies (HTML5 and WebGL).

📵 At this time, CoinsRaid does not have a dedicated Android or iOS app. You can still access the full experience through your mobile browser.

A native mobile app may be introduced later, but there’s no confirmed release date yet. Updates will be shared on our official channels when available.

For the best performance, always keep your browser updated and allow cookies and location services.

articles.title: Responsible Gaming: How It Works
articles.body:
Self-Exclusion, Purchase Limit and Bet Limit are CoinsRaid’s responsible play tools designed to help you take a break from the platform whenever you need it. You can activate them at any time directly from your account settings.

⚠️ Before you self-exclude, please make sure you’ve redeemed any eligible prizes, since you won’t be able to access your account while the exclusion is active.

What Self-Exclusion Does

  • Blocks access to your account for the duration you choose:
    24 hours, 1 week, 1 month, 6 months, 1 year or Permanently
  • Prevents login, gameplay, Gold Coin purchases, and prize redemptions.
  • Applies instantly to your identity.
  • Ensures long-term safety.
❗ Permanent self-exclusion requests cannot be reversed.

What Purchase Limit Does

Purchase Limits allow you to control how much you spend on Gold Coins.

  • Daily Purchase Limit
    Enter the maximum amount you can spend in a single day.
  • Weekly Purchase Limit
    Enter the maximum amount you can spend in a week.
  • Monthly Purchase Limit
    Enter the maximum amount you can spend in a month.

Once set, purchases cannot exceed these limits. Lowering a limit applies immediately.

What Bet Limit Does

Gameplay Limits help you manage how much you play.

  • Daily Bet Limit
    Enter the maximum amount you can play in one day.
  • Weekly Bet Limit
    Enter the maximum amount you can play in a week.
  • Monthly Bet Limit
    Enter the maximum amount you can play in a month.

When a bet limit is reached, gameplay will be restricted until the limit resets.

articles.title: How to get Support
articles.body:
Before contacting support, we recommend checking our Help Center — it contains answers to most common questions about accounts, gameplay, verification, prizes, responsible play, and more.

  1. Visit our Help Center.
  2. Browse categories or use the search bar to quickly find the information you need.

If you can’t find your answer or still need assistance:

  1. Go to the CoinsRaid website at https://coinsraid.com.
  2. Look for the help widget in the bottom-right corner of the screen.
  3. Click the widget to open the chat window.
  4. Choose a topic in the Help Center or click "Ask for help" to type your question in the chat box.

Our team is available 24/7 to help with account questions, verification, technical issues, responsible play tools, and anything else you need.

You can also reach us by email at support@coinsraid.com, but the fastest and most reliable way to receive help is through the chat widget.

articles.title: Keeping Your Account Secure
articles.body:
At CoinsRaid, we take account security seriously and provide tools and best practices to help you protect your information. Here’s how you can keep your account safe:

1. Use a strong, unique password

Choose a password that includes letters, numbers, and symbols. Avoid using personal details (like your name or birthday) or reusing passwords from other sites.

2. Never share your login details

Your CoinsRaid account is personal. Don’t share your password, verification codes, or account access with anyone, including people claiming to be CoinsRaid staff. Our team will never ask for your password or one-time codes.

3. Keep your email secure

Your email is the key to your account. Use a strong password for your email address and enable two-factor authentication (2FA) with your email provider whenever possible.

4. Avoid suspicious links or messages

Always access CoinsRaid directly through coinsraid.com. If you receive a message or email that looks suspicious, do not click any links. Report it to support@coinsraid.com.

5. Stay logged in only on your own devices

Log out after using shared or public computers, and don’t save passwords on devices that aren’t yours.

6. Keep your browser updated

Use the latest version of a supported browser to ensure your data is protected with the newest security standards.

If you think your account has been compromised:

Contact our Support Team immediately — see How to get Support.

articles.title: Email or Login Issues
articles.body:
1. Check your email inbox and spam folder

Verification or password reset emails may sometimes end up in the spam or promotions folder. Search for messages from noreply@coinsraid.com or admin@coinsraid.com and mark them as "Not Spam."

2. Make sure you’re using the correct login method

If you registered using Google or Apple, you’ll need to sign in using the same method. Email and social logins are separate.

3. Verify your email address

If you haven’t confirmed your email yet, look for the verification link we sent after registration. Click the link to complete verification before trying to log in again.

4. Clear your browser cache or try another device

Sometimes login issues are caused by old session data. Try refreshing your browser or logging in from another device.

5. Contact Support if you’re still locked out

If none of the steps above work, reach out to our Support Team at support@coinsraid.com. Please include the email address linked to your account and any error messages you’re seeing. This will help us assist you faster.

Tip: Always make sure you log in only through coinsraid.com and avoid third-party or unofficial links.

articles.title: How to Delete or Close Your Account
articles.body:
If you decide to stop playing, you can request to permanently close your CoinsRaid account at any time.

To request account closure:

  1. Contact our Support Team — see How to get Support.
  2. Our team will confirm your identity and verify that no pending redemptions or compliance reviews remain on your account.
  3. Once confirmed, your account will be permanently closed, and access to gameplay, purchases, and rewards will be removed.

Before closing your account:

  • Make sure all prize redemptions have been completed.
  • Any remaining Gold Coins or unredeemed Sweeps Coins will be forfeited once the account is closed.
  • For regulatory reasons, some account data (such as KYC and transaction records) will be securely retained for a limited period as required by law.

If you simply want to take a break, consider using our Responsible Gaming tools instead — they temporarily pause your access without deleting your account.

articles.title: Why can't I redeem to a gift card or prepaid card?
articles.body:
🚫 Gift cards, store credits, and prepaid cards aren’t available as payout options.

Before any prize can be redeemed, we’re required by law to verify your identity and location.

Gift cards and prepaid cards don’t allow us to do it, so we can’t use them for redemptions.

Redemptions are only available in eligible U.S. states. If you’re in a restricted state, redemption options won’t appear.

What can I redeem instead?

Once your Sweeps Coins are redeemable, your account is verified, and you’re in an eligible state, you’ll see the available redemption options directly in your account.

For more information check How to Redeem Prizes and How to Verify Your Account.

articles.title: Daily Lootbox at CoinsRaid
articles.body:
CoinsRaid offers the Daily Lootbox to reward active players just for coming back. Every day you log in, you can collect free rewards and progress faster in your adventure.

What’s included in the Daily Lootbox:

  • Daily Lootbox with surprise rewards
  • Daily Missions and challenges that unlock extra bonuses
  • Special streak rewards for logging in multiple days in a row

How it works:

  1. Log in to your CoinsRaid account each day
  2. Visit the CoinsRaid Hub
  3. Collect your Daily Lootbox and open it
  4. Complete daily missions to earn even more rewards in Raider’s Guild

All daily rewards are free, no purchase is required, and rewards refresh every day. Missing a day may reset your streak, so make sure to check in daily and keep your adventure going.

For more information about Lootboxes, Missions and Raider’s Guild check these pages: Lootboxes, Missions Guide, Raider’s Guild Guide.

articles.title: Raider's Guild Guide
articles.body:
What Is the Raider's Guild?

The Raider's Guild is CoinsRaid's loyalty progression system. Complete missions, earn XP, and climb through ranks. Each rank unlocks greater rewards in Gold Coins (GC) and FREE Sweeps Coins (FREE SC).

Each rank includes XP milestones you must complete before advancing.

The Guild offers two ways to level up — free and premium — so every player can progress at their preferred pace.

Mission Types

The Raider's Guild includes two mission categories:

A. Progression Missions

(Elite Initiation / Elite Expedition or Frontier Awakening / Frontier Discovery)

These missions are required to level up.

How it works:

  • Complete your rank's Progression Missions to earn XP.
  • Reach the XP milestone to unlock the next level.
  • Every level provides a one-time reward of GC and FREE SC.
  • Once you activate your level-up missions, you have 30 days to finish them.

If you don't complete them in time, progress resets and a fresh 30-day cycle begins. This keeps advancement structured around monthly cycles.

B. Weekly Loyalty Missions

(Weekly Elite Operations or Weekly Frontier Routines)

These missions refresh every 7 days based on your current Raider's Guild level.

Rewards include:

  • GC
  • FREE SC
  • Additional XP to speed up progression

Even after leveling up, weekly missions continue to grant rewards, helping you progress further in the Guild.

Choose Your Progression Route

You can progress through the Raider's Guild using one of two tracks. Each has its own style, pace, and reward curve.

Frontier Tasks: The Free Route

  • 100% purchase-free.
  • Missions include login streaks, exploring slot games, GC turnover goals, and other simple tasks.
  • Designed for steady, accessible progression using GC only.

Perfect for players who want freedom, no commitments, and progress at their own rhythm.

Elite Challenges: The Premium Route

For players seeking faster progression and higher-value rewards.

Benefits include:

  • Larger XP boosts
  • Increased GC and FREE SC rewards
  • High-value progression missions
  • Faster level-ups and enhanced weekly rewards

Elite Challenges may require SC gameplay or unlocking packages, but they offer significantly higher value as you climb the ranks.

Important: Once you choose an Elite Challenge for a specific level or week, Frontier Tasks close for that period. You cannot switch paths until the next cycle.

Tracking Your Journey

All your Raider's Guild details are available in the CoinsRaid Hub.

You can view:

  • Your level, XP progress, and upcoming rewards under The Raider's Guild
  • All active missions under Missions
  • Time remaining for weekly missions and your 30-day progression cycle

Stay on top of your journey and never miss rewards.

articles.title: Missions Guide
articles.body:
Missions are activity-based challenges that shape your adventure, keep you engaged, and reward your consistency on CoinsRaid.

Every mission you complete grants rewards such as Points, GC, FREE SC, Diamonds, and Gems — all helping you progress through the Raider's Guild and unlock valuable perks.

Below is an overview of how each mission category works.

Daily Missions

Daily Missions are quick, simple tasks designed to keep your journey moving day by day.

How they work:

  • Refresh every 24 hours
  • Easy to complete
  • Rewards are credited the same day
  • Ideal for steady, reliable progress

Daily Missions help you build momentum and earn rewards consistently with minimal effort.

Weekly Missions

Weekly Missions introduce larger challenges and offer stronger rewards in return.

What to expect:

  • Tasks such as playing multiple game types or reaching higher turnover milestones
  • Rewards scale with difficulty
  • Earn meaningful boosts of GC, FREE SC, and Points
  • Refresh every 7 days

Weekly Missions are perfect for players who want bigger progression jumps throughout the week.

Monthly Missions

Monthly Missions represent long-term goals that reward commitment and dedication.

Key features:

  • Stretch across the entire month
  • Encourage consistent engagement
  • Offer some of the highest-value mission rewards
  • Provide ongoing incentives for players who play regularly

Monthly Missions deliver substantial bonuses for staying active over time.

Exclusive & Event Missions

From time to time, you may receive limited-time or seasonal missions tied to special promotions.

These missions provide:

  • Bonus opportunities to earn GC, FREE SC, and Points
  • Unique objectives during events, holidays, or feature launches
  • Rewards that go beyond the standard mission cycle

Event Missions are your chance to accelerate progress whenever special campaigns appear.

Where to Track Your Missions

All mission categories (Daily, Weekly, Monthly, and Special) are available inside the CoinsRaid Hub under Missions.

You can always check:

  • Which missions are active
  • Reward summaries
  • Progress toward completion
  • Refresh timers

articles.title: Lootboxes
articles.body:
Lootboxes are your daily surprise chests, a fun way to collect fresh bonuses every day. Each Lootbox offers a mix of random rewards designed to boost your progress on CoinsRaid.

Frequency

  • A new Lootbox becomes available every day.
  • Simply log in to unlock and claim your rewards.

Daily Lootboxes help maintain steady momentum by giving you something valuable to look forward to each day.

Rewards

Each Lootbox contains a randomized combination of helpful items such as:

  • GC
  • FREE SC
  • Points
  • Free spins
  • Extra missions
  • Gems
  • Diamonds

The variety ensures every opening feels exciting and meaningful, offering new advantages for your progression.

Purpose

Lootboxes exist to:

  • Provide random daily boosts
  • Encourage consistent engagement
  • Add variety and surprise to your adventure
  • Support progression through the Raider's Guild and mission system

Every Lootbox is a small step toward bigger rewards, making your daily login more rewarding and enjoyable.

articles.title: Store
articles.body:
The Store is your upgrade hub. It is the place where you exchange your collected Points, Gems, or Diamonds for powerful items that boost your progress and enhance your CoinsRaid adventure.

Currencies

You'll earn several types of progression currencies as you play:

  • Points
  • Gems
  • Diamonds

These are obtained through missions, the Daily Lootbox, special promotions, or seasonal events. Each currency may unlock different tiers of Store items.

Items Available in the Store

The Store offers a rotating selection of progression-enhancing items, including:

  • Purchase bonuses
  • Free spins
  • Discounts
  • Exclusive missions
  • Special perks that accelerate leveling and rewards

These items help you push further through the Raider's Guild and maximize your overall progression.

Availability & Access

The Store experience adapts to your activity:

  • Certain items may have purchase limits
  • Some perks unlock only after reaching specific levels
  • Availability may vary based on your account status, progression route, or recent mission activity

This ensures that rewards stay balanced, personalized, and meaningful at every stage of your journey.

Ongoing Updates

The Store is refreshed regularly, introducing new boosts, seasonal offers, and limited-time items to keep your adventure exciting.
